text: This is AgentLedger. It audits the JSON log of an AI agent run, entirely in your browser. Everything in this demo is synthetic sample data, marked SAMPLE.
You choose the bar for five controls: traceability, versioning, hallucination rate, human oversight, and groundedness. Each threshold is editable, and it is saved with every audit.
The groundedness check is optional. It uses your own Anthropic API key, which stays in this tab's memory and is never saved. In this demo, we leave it empty.
Now, upload a run. This sample trace has a user question, a tool output, and two model answers.

Each control is scored against your thresholds. Traceability passes: every step has an ID. Versioning fails: only the two answers record a model version. Hallucination rate and human oversight are not evidenced, because the log has no labels for them. Missing data is never counted as a pass.
Groundedness is not evidenced either. No key was given, so no call was made. The method, the model, and the prompt version are shown on the result.
Every result links to the exact log entry it came from. Click a step, and you land on the source, with the field each control read.
The report page gives the overall opinion, and exports to Markdown or PDF, generated on this device.

Each audit is also written to a local ledger. Every record carries the SHA-256 hash of the record before it. Verify ledger recomputes the whole chain, and names the exact record if anything was changed.
AgentLedger. Evidence-linked results, never invented, in a tamper-evident ledger.
